# Paylov developer docs

Verbatim mirror of every English page on [developer.paylov.uz](https://developer.paylov.uz), one
file per page at its URL path. Each file records its `source_url`, and its
`## Notes (extraction)` lists source bugs and differences from the Russian and Uzbek pages. Never
edit by hand; replace the whole mirror through the
[sync-paylov-reference skill](../../../.agents/skills/sync-paylov-reference/SKILL.md). The cleaned
reference for SDK work is [`docs/paylov/`](../../paylov/README.md).
